sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK A. Readback and Hearback

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, taxi to holding point runway tree 6 via Alpha.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, after departure climb straight ahead to 2,000 feet, cleared for takeoff runway tree 6, wind calm.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, climb and maintain flight level tree 50, contact Sejong Control on 128.25.

body.label: Delivery
body.text: HL123, cleared to Muan Airport via the PALDA ONE departure, maintain 5,000 feet, squawk 5721.

sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK B. Checking, Clarifying, Confirming, Informing

body.text: You have just been handed over to Sejong Control while climbing out. You are passing 9,000 feet for flight level 180, and you are not sure whether your cleared level has been changed. Contact Sejong Control, report your present altitude, and confirm your cleared level.

While crossing PALDA you encountered moderate turbulence for about two minutes at flight level tree 50. You changed frequency before you could report it, so the new controller does not know about it yet. Acknowledge the instruction, and report the turbulence you encountered.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, Sejong Control, descend to flight level 2 tree 0, report reaching.

Centre instructed you to maintain Mach decimal 7 8 for separation. You have been in light turbulence and you reduced to Mach decimal 7 4, and you are flying at decimal 7 4 now. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, confirm maintaining Mach decimal 7 8?
Mach .74 / turbulence

The routing direct to TOPLA requires RNP 1. Your number two navigation receiver is inoperative today, so you are not RNP 1 capable. Listen to the controller, make a readback of what you can accept, and a request with a reason.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, cleared direct TOPLA.
Centre instructed you to turn left heading 2 tree 0. You read the number the wrong way round and you are now steady on heading 2 0 tree. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, say your heading.

Your diversion around a closed area has used more fuel than you planned. You now have one hour forty minutes of fuel on board, and your alternate needs one hour ten. You are level at flight level tree 50 approaching NOSOK. Contact Sejong Control. Report your fuel state, and request a more direct routing.
1 hour 40 minutes / request direct

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK A. Role-play & Follow-up

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, level at flight level tree 50 and approaching PALDA, en route to Muan Airport.

body.text: Contact Sejong Control and report your position.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and inquire how many extra track miles this will add.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, Sejong Control, the military training area west of NOSOK is active, so route direct KARBU then NOSOK, descend to flight level 2 tree 0.

pre.text: Situation Update The re-route has added track miles and your fuel is now tighter than you planned. You have one hour 45 minutes of fuel on board.

body.text: Contact the controller, report your fuel state, and request direct NOSOK as soon as the area is clear.
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, roger, expect direct NOSOK in about ten miles. Descend to 1 tree thousand feet, contact Muan Approach on 119.2.

pre.text: Situation Update You are now descending through flight level 150 for 1 tree thousand feet, and the training area is behind you.

body.text: Contact Muan Approach and report your passing altitude.
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Muan Approach, descend to 4,000 feet, reduce speed to 210 knots, expect the NOSOK TWO arrival, ILS runway tree 6, Muan altimeter 1012.
Listen to the controller's question and respond accordingly. Tell him what you need to know before you decide.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, the Airbus A321 ahead of you reported braking action medium on runway tree 6, and it is still raining. Are you happy to continue, or do you want the longer runway at Daegu?
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, turn left heading 020, descend to 2,500 feet until established, cleared for the ILS runway tree 6 approach, contact Muan Tower on 118.55.

pre.text: Situation Update You are established on the ILS for runway tree 6 and passing 2,000 feet.

body.text: Contact Muan Tower, report your position, and request the latest braking action.

Follow-up question: In this situation, the controller told you the aircraft ahead had reported braking action medium on a wet runway. What did you want to know before you decided, and why did that matter to you? From your own experience, what makes you decide to divert to a longer runway instead of continuing? Give an example.

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK B. Extended Role-play : Single Incident/Emergency Related

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, climbing through 8,000 feet for flight level 180 after departure from Gimhae. You have just been handed to Sejong Control.

body.text: Contact Sejong Control and report your position.
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, Sejong Control, radar contact, climb and maintain flight level 2 tree 0, proceed direct TOPLA.

pre.text: Situation Update Passing flight level 150 you get an ENGINE 1 FIRE warning. You have shut the engine down and discharged the first bottle, and the warning has now gone out. You are flying on one engine.

body.text: Declare an emergency, state the nature of the problem, and request a return to Gimhae.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback and say your intentions.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, roger your mayday, turn left heading 180, descend to 1 tree thousand feet, Gimhae is at your eight o'clock and 25 miles. Say your intentions.

pre.text: Situation Update The cabin crew report no injuries. You have two hours 50 minutes of fuel remaining and 164 people on board.

body.text: Listen to the controller's question and provide the requested information.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, say fuel endurance and souls on board.
Listen to the controller and state your intentions, with a reason.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, Gimhae is reporting a crosswind of 20 knots on runway tree 6, and Daegu is 40 miles further with calm wind and a longer runway. Which would you rather have?

pre.text: Situation Update You have completed the checklist, the fire has not come back, and the aircraft is stable on one engine.

body.text: Contact approach, give them an update of your situation, and state what you will need on landing.
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Gimhae Approach, turn right heading 290, descend to 2,500 feet until established, cleared for the ILS runway tree 6 approach, the emergency services are standing by.
Listen to the controller's question and respond accordingly.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, do you want to cancel the emergency now that the engine is secured, or keep it active until you are on the ground?

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK C. Reporting about Task B

pre.text: HL123, Sejong Control, radar contact, climb and maintain flight level 2 tree 0, proceed direct TOPLA.

body.text: What happened to your aircraft (HL123)? Explain the nature of the incident.
How do you think the incident was handled by the air traffic controller? Do you feel the situation could have been handled differently? Make a comment from a pilot's point of view.
